falsifiers.statement: CellUptakeReceipt relies on _factory_seal identity to distinguish factory observations, but _factory_seal is an init=True dataclass field. Python dataclasses.replace preserves init fields that are not explicitly replaced. Therefore replace() of a legitimately factory-produced receipt preserves the exact _RECEIPT_SEAL object while allowing delivery/uptake/downstream fields to be changed to another internally valid combination. assert_broadcast_binding() checks the preserved seal and broadcast/recipient identity but does not re-observe or rederive uptake semantics. summarize_uptake() then accepts the replaced receipt as factory-produced evidence.
falsifiers.minimal_regression: Start from CellUptakeReceipt.observe(... delivery_status='DELIVERED', uptake_status='NOT_UPTAKEN', downstream_ref=None, downstream_sha256=None). Then dataclasses.replace(receipt, uptake_status='UPTAKEN', downstream_ref='forged:downstream', downstream_sha256='f'*64). The replacement preserves _factory_seal and satisfies __post_init__. A correct fail-closed boundary must reject this as non-observed semantic mutation rather than let summarize_uptake promote it to UPTAKE_OBSERVED.
falsifiers.wp510_impact: F2-WP-510 currently protects forged UptakeSummary and forged CausalInfluenceResult by deterministic rederivation, but it rederives from supplied CellUptakeReceipt values. If the supplied receipt itself carries a copied valid factory seal after replace(), rebuilding the summary/result cannot distinguish the semantic forgery. This can manufacture UPTAKE_OBSERVED at repository-component scope and can propagate into CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED_AT_CONTRACT_SCOPE when declared matched-probe outputs differ.
falsifiers.credit_boundary: This falsifier concerns repository-component evidence integrity only. It does not prove target runtime execution, hidden-state causality, world truth, effects, physical GRID10, J-Space, training or whole-system behavior.

contradictions: F2-WP-507 G4 is marked ACCEPTED at repository-hosted component-CI scope, but its observation-factory seal is copyable through dataclasses.replace and therefore does not currently establish immutable observation provenance for CellUptakeReceipt semantic fields.
F2-WP-510 generation 1 depends on exact WP507 receipt lineage, so its acceptance must be withheld or explicitly narrowed until this falsifier is repaired or independently disproved.
completion_deficit: Add an executable regression for dataclasses.replace receipt semantic mutation. Repair the trust boundary so factory provenance cannot be copied into modified observation semantics, for example by making the seal non-init/recreated in a way replace cannot preserve and requiring deterministic validator lineage, or by binding receipt identity/digest to immutable observation evidence that downstream consumers independently verify. Then rerun WP507 and dependent WP510 integration tests at exact repaired source identity.
next_exact_action: Reproduce the replace-seal attack in repository-hosted CI against the exact accepted WP507 G4 source. If reproduced, reconcile WP507 G4 as post-acceptance falsified at observation-provenance scope, open one successor repair authority, and replay WP510 only after the repaired receipt boundary is exact-current.
